answerable.question: What was the revenue for the 20 mm Double sided bubble wrap 50m in Texas in March 2015?
answerable.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.extendedprice), 2) 
FROM sales.invoicelines il
JOIN sales.invoices i          ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN warehouse.stockitems si   ON si.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
JOIN sales.customers c         ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
JOIN application.cities ct     ON ct.cityid = c.deliverycityid
JOIN application.stateprovinces sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ct.stateprovinceid
 WHERE si.stockitemname = '20 mm Double sided bubble wrap 50m' AND sp.stateprovincename = 'Texas' AND i.invoicedate >= '2015-03-01' AND i.invoicedate < '2015-04-01'

answerable.question: How many invoice lines were there on invoices dated in March 2016?
answerable.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM sales.invoicelines il
JOIN sales.invoices i          ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN warehouse.stockitems si   ON si.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
JOIN sales.customers c         ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
JOIN application.cities ct     ON ct.cityid = c.deliverycityid
JOIN application.stateprovinces sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ct.stateprovinceid
 WHERE i.invoicedate >= '2016-03-01' AND i.invoicedate < '2016-04-01'

answerable.question: What was the total revenue from customers in the Gift Store category in 2015?

JOIN sales.invoices i          ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN warehouse.stockitems si   ON si.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
JOIN sales.customers c         ON c.customerid = i.customerid

answerable.question: Which are the top 3 stock items by total revenue across all time? List their names.
answerable.sql:
SELECT si.stockitemname, ROUND(SUM(il.extendedprice), 2) AS revenue 
FROM sales.invoicelines il
JOIN sales.invoices i          ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
JOIN warehouse.stockitems si   ON si.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
JOIN sales.customers c         ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
JOIN application.cities ct     ON ct.cityid = c.deliverycityid
JOIN application.stateprovinces sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ct.stateprovinceid
  GROUP BY si.stockitemname ORDER BY SUM(il.extendedprice) DESC LIMIT 3

certify.question: What was the gross margin percentage across all invoice lines in 2015?

JOIN warehouse.stockitems si   ON si.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
JOIN sales.customers c         ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
JOIN application.cities ct     ON ct.cityid = c.deliverycityid
JOIN application.stateprovinces sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = ct.stateprovinceid
